semantics.latency: combinational propagation only; no cycle latency
semantics.input_acceptance: output continuously reflects current inputs; no handshake

numeric.operations: Boolean only, no arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow
numeric.index_order: abcd with a most significant when enumerating minterms

verification.oracle: literal original K-map rows indexed by cd and columns by ab using Gray ordering, independently of RTL equation
verification.coverage: exhaust all 16 binary inputs in ascending and descending order
verification.comparison: case inequality against exact one-bit expected value after combinational settling
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp
verification.timeout: finite external timeout for each compile and simulation, plus testbench watchdog
verification.scope: development simulation only; no synthesis or official evaluation

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z inputs is not specified; binary truth-table behavior is required.
